newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Total rises in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Total rises in New York.

text.p: Shares in French oil company Total SA rose on Wednesday in otherwise quiet trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), analysts said.
Most ADRs followed the Dow Jones Industrial Average as it surged at the opening and then eased.
"Now we've seen settling back, in drifting conditions," a trader said. "Everything is stable."
Total's stock rose 1/2 to 40-3/8 after it reported sales for the first nine months of 1996 were up 24.7 percent.
Among other European ADRs, British power generator National Power Plc fell 1-3/4 to 29-7/8 after it reported its half-year profits had slipped from a year earlier.
British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc rose 1-1/4 to 52-7/8 following Granada Group Plc's comments that it planned to keep its 10.8 percent stake in the satellite operator.
Japan's Canon Inc rose 3-29/32 to a 12-month high of 108-25/32 in a follow-on after Tokyo investors drove it and other blue-chip shares higher.
Latin American shares were quiet, with Mexico's exchange closed for a holiday. Brazilian bellwether Telebras was off 1/8 to 74-1/2.
Advancers led decliners by a margin of 242 to 198 among an 807-ADR index. Volume in late morning was 23.5 million shares.
